headline: Brazil Central Bank Announces FX Line Auctions Totaling Up to $2 Billion
summary: Brazil's central bank announced foreign exchange line auctions totaling up to $2 billion, with operations scheduled to be settled on December 2.
why: Central bank foreign exchange interventions are deployed to manage liquidity and stabilize domestic currency fluctuations against global economic pressures.

impacts.name: USD/BRL
impacts.why: Direct central bank liquidity injections through FX lines influence foreign exchange market pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank's announcement of multi-billion dollar foreign exchange auctions adjusts currency liquidity directly in the domestic financial system.
